question.en: Which parasite can control the behavior of ants, making them climb plants before dying?
question.ms: Parasit manakah boleh mengawal tingkah laku semut sehingga memanjat tumbuhan sebelum mati?

funFact.en: This fungus infects ants and forces them to climb vegetation before releasing spores.
funFact.ms: Kulat ini menjangkiti semut dan memaksanya memanjat tumbuhan sebelum melepaskan spora.

question.en: Which deep-sea fish has a transparent head allowing it to see upward through its skull?
question.ms: Ikan laut dalam manakah mempunyai kepala lutsinar yang membolehkannya melihat melalui tengkoraknya?

funFact.en: The barreleye fish has tubular eyes inside a transparent dome.
funFact.ms: Ikan barreleye mempunyai mata berbentuk tiub di dalam kubah lutsinar.

question.en: Which animal can survive complete dehydration by entering a state called cryptobiosis?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup selepas kehilangan hampir semua air badan melalui keadaan dipanggil kriptobiosis?

funFact.en: Tardigrades can lose almost all body water and revive years later.
funFact.ms: Tardigrade boleh kehilangan hampir semua air badan dan hidup semula bertahun kemudian.

question.en: Which animal can detach and regrow its tail as a defense mechanism?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh memutuskan ekornya dan menumbuhkan semula sebagai pertahanan?

funFact.en: The detached tail can wiggle to distract predators.
funFact.ms: Ekor yang terputus boleh bergerak untuk mengalih perhatian pemangsa.

question.en: Which marine worm can grow over 50 meters long, making it one of the longest animals on Earth?
question.ms: Cacing laut manakah boleh membesar lebih 50 meter, menjadikannya antara haiwan terpanjang di Bumi?

funFact.en: Bootlace worms are among the longest animals ever recorded.
funFact.ms: Cacing bootlace antara haiwan terpanjang pernah direkodkan.

question.en: Which fish uses a glowing lure to attract prey in the dark ocean depths?
question.ms: Ikan manakah menggunakan umpan bercahaya untuk menarik mangsa di laut gelap?

funFact.en: The lure contains bioluminescent bacteria.
funFact.ms: Umpan itu mengandungi bakteria bioluminesen.

question.en: Which bird has the highest recorded flight altitude among birds?
question.ms: Burung manakah mempunyai rekod terbang paling tinggi antara burung?

funFact.en: This vulture has been recorded flying over 11,000 meters high.
funFact.ms: Burung nasar ini pernah direkodkan terbang lebih 11,000 meter.

question.en: Which plant can generate heat to melt snow around it?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah boleh menghasilkan haba untuk mencairkan salji di sekelilingnya?

funFact.en: Skunk cabbage produces heat through cellular respiration.
funFact.ms: Kubis skunk menghasilkan haba melalui respirasi sel.

question.en: Which animal has teeth strong enough to chew through bamboo all day?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai gigi cukup kuat untuk mengunyah buluh sepanjang hari?

funFact.en: Pandas spend up to 14 hours per day eating bamboo.
funFact.ms: Panda boleh menghabiskan sehingga 14 jam sehari makan buluh.

question.en: Which ocean predator can detect prey using pressure changes in water?
question.ms: Pemangsa laut manakah boleh mengesan mangsa melalui perubahan tekanan air?

funFact.en: Sharks use a sensory system called the lateral line.
funFact.ms: Hiu menggunakan sistem deria dipanggil garis lateral.

question.en: Which insect species spends up to 17 years underground before emerging?
question.ms: Spesies serangga manakah menghabiskan sehingga 17 tahun di bawah tanah sebelum muncul?

funFact.en: Some cicadas emerge in massive synchronized swarms.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah cicada muncul dalam kawanan besar serentak.

question.en: Which animal can rotate its eyes independently to look in two directions?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh memusingkan mata secara bebas ke dua arah berbeza?

funFact.en: Chameleons can focus both eyes on the same target when hunting.
funFact.ms: Chameleon boleh menumpukan kedua-dua mata pada satu sasaran ketika memburu.

question.en: Which mammal lays eggs instead of giving birth to live young?
question.ms: Mamalia manakah bertelur dan bukannya melahirkan anak hidup?

funFact.en: Platypuses are monotremes, one of the few egg-laying mammals.
funFact.ms: Platipus ialah monotrem, antara mamalia yang bertelur.

question.en: Which creature is capable of producing its own light through bioluminescence?
question.ms: Makhluk manakah boleh menghasilkan cahaya sendiri melalui bioluminesens?

funFact.en: Fireflies use light signals to attract mates.
funFact.ms: Kelip-kelip menggunakan cahaya untuk menarik pasangan.

question.en: Which sea creature can inflate its body to scare predators?
question.ms: Makhluk laut manakah boleh mengembungkan badan untuk menakutkan pemangsa?

funFact.en: Pufferfish inflate by rapidly swallowing water.
funFact.ms: Ikan buntal mengembung dengan menelan air dengan cepat.

question.en: Which animal has the longest recorded lifespan among reptiles?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai jangka hayat paling panjang antara reptilia?

funFact.en: Some giant tortoises have lived over 150 years.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah kura-kura gergasi hidup lebih 150 tahun.

question.en: Which insect can walk on water using surface tension?
question.ms: Serangga manakah boleh berjalan di atas air menggunakan tegangan permukaan?

funFact.en: Water striders have hydrophobic legs that repel water.
funFact.ms: Pepijat air mempunyai kaki hidrofobik yang menolak air.

question.en: Which animal has a heart located in its head?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai jantung di dalam kepalanya?

funFact.en: The shrimp's heart is located in the cephalothorax near its head.
funFact.ms: Jantung udang terletak di bahagian cephalothorax berhampiran kepala.

question.en: Which deep-sea creature can survive pressures hundreds of times greater than at the surface?
question.ms: Makhluk laut dalam manakah boleh hidup dalam tekanan ratusan kali lebih tinggi daripada di permukaan?

funFact.en: Deep-sea amphipods live in trenches deeper than 7,000 meters.
funFact.ms: Amfipod laut dalam hidup di parit laut lebih dalam daripada 7,000 meter.

question.en: Which plant emits a smell similar to rotting flesh to attract pollinators?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah mengeluarkan bau seperti daging busuk untuk menarik pendebunga?

funFact.en: The corpse flower produces one of the largest blooms in the world.
funFact.ms: Bunga bangkai menghasilkan salah satu bunga terbesar di dunia.
